title: Berlinale Talents 2027 - Call for Application
description: Join 200 emerging filmmakers at the Berlinale Talents Summit in Berlin, the Berlinale talent development programme.
descriptionDetailed: Berlinale Talents is the talent development programme of the Berlin International Film Festival, offering a six-day Summit, a project lab, and the Talent Project Market. Around 200 emerging filmmakers worldwide are selected to join talks, workshops, and networking in February, gaining mentorship and access to the film industry.

entry.feeNote: The application service fee is €15 at the standard rate and €10 for the early bird rate, which applies to applications submitted by August 19, 2026

prize.prizeSummary: Place in the Berlinale Talents programme with a six-day Summit in Berlin, mentorship, and industry networking
prize.description: Selected participants join around 200 emerging filmmakers for the Berlinale Talents Summit during the Berlin International Film Festival in February 2027. The programme includes talks, workshops, and think tanks, project development through the Berlinale Talents Lab, and the Talent Project Market, along with mentorship, networking with industry professionals, and long-term alumni support.

audience.eligibilityLabel: For film professionals with an existing track record
audience.eligibilityDetail: Open to filmmakers, series, and XR content creators with an existing track record of work who are willing to share their experience. Applicants need at least one feature-length film, two short films, or a high-quality drama series or TV movie that has screened in festivals or been widely streamed. Students are admitted only in exceptional cases, such as previous work in the film business.
